{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Identifying actionable, attention-worthy signals in food-product reviews — i.e. what customers care about (issues) and how much a review matters/warrants attention",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "sentiment_label", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Polarity is a core facet of what's worth attention (negative reviews flag problems); directly relevant to actionability."},
    {"name": "helpfulness_ratio", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Proxy for how much a review matters to other users — a legitimate attention/prioritisation facet."},
    {"name": "review_length_bucket", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Bucketed text length is a generic surface metric, not a substantive attention/issue facet."},
    {"name": "issue_flags", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Multi-label extraction of concrete concerns (taste, shipping, quality, value, health) is the strongest actionable facet — directly names what's worth attention."},
    {"name": "repeat_buy_signal", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Repeat-purchase intent is a meaningful, actionable outcome signal tied to product quality."},
    {"name": "exclamation_count", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Raw punctuation count is a mechanical surface metric; only weak, undifferentiated proxy for intensity."},
    {"name": "caps_ratio", "supports_focus": false, "rationale": "Capitalisation ratio is a generic stylistic/noise metric, not a substantive facet of what's actionable."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.6,
  "structure_quality": 0.55,
  "focus_actionability": 0.8,
  "rationale": "A coherent actionability-focused core exists: issue_flags, sentiment_label, repeat_buy_signal, and helpfulness_ratio collectively centre on 'what's worth attention/action in reviews' — issue_flags in particular is a rich, well-structured, directly actionable decomposition of customer concerns. However coherence and structure are diluted by three mechanical surface metrics (review_length_bucket, exclamation_count, caps_ratio) that add generic text-statistics noise rather than facets of the implied focus, pulling the set partway toward a grab-bag. The implied focus is genuinely actionable (an analyst can triage by issue type, sentiment, and helpfulness), so actionability scores high, but the mix of substantive and mechanical columns caps focus_coherence and structure_quality in the middle range."
}
